title.original: Context as a Tool: Context Management for Long-Horizon SWE-Agents
title.zh: 上下文作为工具：长期SWE代理的上下文管理
title.en: Context as a Tool: Context Management for Long-Horizon SWE-Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: CAT 把结构化上下文工作区、主动压缩工具和轨迹级监督实现为长程 Agent 可复用的上下文控制层。
inclusion_reason.en: CAT implements a structured workspace, proactive compression tool, and trajectory-level supervision as a reusable context-control layer for long-horizon agents.

abstract.zh: CAT 将上下文维护提升为 SWE Agent 可主动调用的工具。它把工作区拆为稳定任务语义、压缩长期记忆和高保真短期交互，并训练 SWE-Compressor 在合适里程碑把历史轨迹压成可操作摘要。
abstract.en: CAT turns context maintenance into a tool that software-engineering agents can invoke proactively. It divides the workspace into stable task semantics, compressed long-term memory, and high-fidelity recent interaction, and trains SWE-Compressor to summarize trajectories at useful milestones.

problem.zh: 长周期代码任务采用追加式上下文或被动阈值压缩时，容易发生上下文爆炸、语义漂移和关键仓库证据丢失。
problem.en: Append-only context and passive threshold compression in long software tasks cause context explosion, semantic drift, and loss of repository evidence.

approach.zh: CAT-GENERATOR 离线在完整轨迹中注入上下文管理动作，形成轨迹级监督；训练出的压缩器由 Agent 自主决定何时整理历史，并写回结构化工作区。
approach.en: CAT-GENERATOR injects context-management actions into full trajectories to create trajectory-level supervision; the trained compressor lets the agent choose when to condense history and update the structured workspace.

system_design.zh: 运行时把 context-management 作为普通动作暴露给 Agent，工具读取当前三段式工作区、生成里程碑摘要并更新长期段，同时保留最近交互的原始细节。
system_design.en: The runtime exposes context management as an ordinary agent action. The tool reads the three-part workspace, writes a milestone summary into long-term state, and preserves recent interactions at full fidelity.

key_results.zh: 在 SWE-Bench-Verified 上，SWE-Compressor 被报告比 ReAct 和静态压缩基线解决更多任务，并在固定上下文预算下保持较稳定的长程推理。
key_results.en: On SWE-Bench-Verified, SWE-Compressor is reported to solve more tasks than ReAct and static-compression baselines while sustaining long-horizon reasoning within a bounded context budget.

limitations.zh: 监督由离线注入动作构造，可能偏向训练轨迹的里程碑模式；压缩一旦遗漏关键信息难以恢复，跨非 SWE 任务的适用性也未建立。
limitations.en: Supervision comes from injected offline actions and may reflect training-trajectory milestone patterns; omitted evidence is hard to recover, and transfer beyond software engineering is not established.

metrics.name: context budget
metrics.value: bounded context with stable long-horizon reasoning

notes.zh: 模型名、SWE-Bench-Verified、两类基线和解决率来自官方摘要；底座模型、硬件、上下文长度和成本待全文审计。
notes.en: Model name, SWE-Bench-Verified, two baseline classes, and solved rate come from the official abstract; base model, hardware, context length, and cost await full-text audit.
